system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Memorystore Redis instance (Basic tier, 1 GB) for application caching.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: redis-cache
  type: gcp-types/redis-v1beta1:projects.locations.instances
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ env["project"] }}/locations/{{ properties["region"] }}
    instanceId: {{ properties["name"] }}
    tier: BASIC
    memorySizeGb: 1
    locationId: {{ properties["region"] }}
    redisVersion: REDIS_6_X
    authorizedNetwork: {{ properties["network"] }}
    connectMode: DIRECT_PEERING
    maintenancePolicy:
      weeklyMaintenanceWindow:
        day: SUNDAY
        startTime:
          hours: 2
          minutes: 0
    redisConfigs:
      maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru
    labels:
      environment: {{ properties["environment"] }}
      application: {{ properties["application"] }}

outputs:
- name: redisHost
  value: $(ref.{{ properties["name"] }}.host)
- name: redisPort
  value: $(ref.{{ properties["name"] }}.port)
- name: redisConnectionString
  value: $(ref.{{ properties["name"] }}.host):$(ref.{{ properties["name"] }}.port)
